access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3481) from the museum's open-access image. A woman's straw boater: a flat-topped straight-sided crown of plaited straw in a warm golden tan, a flat brim of even width, a broad black silk ribbon round the crown. A real hat, American, in colour, about fourteen years before the scene; the form is the one the 1904 drawings show.
note: A reference picture for the 1904 parlor maid's sailor hat, Christine Nelson of the Glessner household (data/humans/recipes/errand_1904.json).
